body:
A independently reviewed design9af7fb8b and authorizes bounded SOURCE-ONLY implementation with one mandatory correction. Parent bridge must carry fresh bindingUUID/generation in addition to NSWindow identity: stale dismantle/update from older representable bound to SAME NSWindow must not clear/shutdown newer host binding or active ticket. Test same-window rebind then old teardown; only exact current binding may shutdown. No global/window-identity-only shutdown on stale callback. Root/Luna both found this condition.
Implement scoped design using tests-first separate commits and minimal test seam/API skeleton if required, then separate production adapter commit. Preserve existing actual e51 failure and explicit unseen-lifetime regression; A will establish behavioral RED/green, do not suppress it or replace with weak bookkeeping assertions. New tests may migrate from inferred-probe API to owned driver contract but retain outcomes/ordering/negative controls, including wholly unseen attachment with live view, reentrant cancellation/completion, native queued captured sheet, physical membership still present, parent close, stale same-window bridge generation, nested chooser held/reentrantcancel.
Use current integration source010617b8 on origin/codex/document-save-dismiss-integration as baseline to preserve accepted current-main Layers/status/activation and recovery APIs. A main now30f005d9 includes statusfix291857e1; do not edit AppModel or transplant oldDocumentWorkspace. New adapter/DocumentSheets/WorkspaceSaveAs/ContentView only, no theme, dependencies or other sheet changes. Form and Replace use distinct owned invocation tokens; never end unowned/lookupattachedSheet; wait completion AND exactparent membershipclear. Explicitly verify NSWindow.sheets queued cancellation contract; no guessed syntheticevent proof. Retain existing keyboard/AX identifiers/layout, sourcefilename and chosenfolder behavior. Use weak action owners and bounded draincontext; release observers/windows on retirement; no source of hidden leaks. Child chooser cancel must target capturedpanel only and defer parentend until childreturn; no global abortModal. Document supported shutdown/lifetime assumptions.
No B compile/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat restart. Publish tests and product source separately with handoff UNRUN; A owns compiler/GUI/full validation/main. Notify if implementation exposes design gap before weakening safety/liveness.
